reason: Provides an analyze_image tool that reads images and forwards them with user prompts to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint, including support for pasted attachments and WebUI configuration.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供 analyze_image 工具，可读取本地或粘贴的图片并转发至用户配置的兼容 OpenAI 的视觉端点进行分析。
summaries.en: Adds an analyze_image tool that reads local or pasted images and forwards them to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for analysis.

capabilities: Reads local image files, HTTP(S) image URLs, data URLs, and in-session image attachments
Sends image data and prompts to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Stores and manages endpoint settings and API key configuration through a WebUI panel
Rewrites pasted image messages for text-only models and invokes the analyze_image tool
